author: axinging
title: Docker_arm64 build fails - Azure Container Registry unreachable (connection refused)
signature: docker buildx failed to resolve source metadata connection refused azure container registry|External Service

failed_jobs.name: Docker_arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: docker buildx build failed to resolve source metadata for openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/dockerio/library/ubuntu:22.04 due to connection refused

key_errors: 09-18-2026 11:55:02 run  INFO  #2 ERROR: failed to do request: Head "https://openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/v2/dockerio/library/ubuntu/manifests/22.04": dial tcp 172.16.0.197:443: connect: connection refused

09-18-2026 11:55:02 run  INFO  ERROR: failed to solve: openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/dockerio/library/ubuntu:22.04: failed to resolve source metadata for openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/dockerio/library/ubuntu:22.04: failed to do request: Head ...

RuntimeError: Command 'docker buildx build --builder=builder-3776b8a9-5fb8-4c5c-a9f9-d1a874ad48b0 ... --tag openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/ov_test/ubuntu_22_04_arm64:pr-38160 ...' returned non-zero exit status
root_cause: The Docker_arm64 job invokes docker buildx build, which needs to pull the base ubuntu:22.04 image mirrored through the self-hosted Azure Container Registry (openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io). The build agent's outbound connection to the registry's IP (172.16.0.197:443) was refused, indicating a transient network/infrastructure issue reaching the ACR endpoint from the runner rather than any problem in the PR's code changes (which only touch src/core/src/runtime/aligned_buffer.cpp and its test). The run's second attempt (run_attempt=2) subsequently succeeded for Docker_arm64, confirming the failure was transient and unrelated to the PR content.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network connectivity issue between the GitHub Actions runner and openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io; not reproducible locally or deterministically in CI.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Docker_arm64 job (a retry already succeeded on run_attempt=2, confirming transience).
No code changes needed for this PR (#38004); the failure is unrelated to the changed files.
If this ACR connectivity issue recurs frequently, escalate to infra/DevOps to check ACR endpoint health/network peering for the affected runner pool.
prevention_strategies: Add retry/backoff logic around docker buildx pulls of base images from the internal ACR mirror, or configure a fallback registry mirror, to reduce the impact of transient network blips.
historical_context: Similar Azure Container Registry connectivity failures have occurred before (pattern 2831f4ffa148d7b6: 'failed to fetch oauth token docker registry connection refused', External Service, first seen 2026-07-15) though with a different specific error string (OAuth token fetch vs. manifest HEAD request). Both point to intermittent reachability issues with openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io from CI runners.
